subject: Matemática
description_pt: Planejar e executar pesquisa amostral envolvendo tema da realidade social e comunicar os resultados por meio de relatório contendo avaliação de medidas de tendência central e da amplitude, tabelas e gráficos adequados, construídos com o apoio de planilhas eletrônicas.

components.description_pt: Planejar uma pesquisa amostral sobre tema relevante à realidade social
components.description_en: Plan a sample survey on a topic relevant to social reality
components.cc_component_description: Identify situations as either sample surveys, experiments, or observational studies

components.description_pt: Coletar e organizar dados de pesquisa em tabelas e gráficos usando software de planilha
components.description_en: Collect and organize survey data into appropriate tables and graphs using spreadsheet software
components.cc_component_description: Organize and represent data with up to three categories

components.description_pt: Resumir conjuntos de dados numéricos em relação ao seu contexto calculando medidas quantitativas de tendência central
components.description_en: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by calculating quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean)

components.description_pt: Comunicar resultados de pesquisa através de relatório escrito com análise e visualizações
components.description_en: Communicate survey results through a written report including data analysis and visualizations
components.cc_component_description: Interpret mathematical results within the context of a real-world scenario

cc_matches.description: *Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered.
Recognize the purposes of and differences among sample surveys, experiments, and observational studies; explain how randomization relates to each.

Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories; ask and answer questions about the total number of data points, how many in each category, and how many more or less are in one category than in another.
